items.title: 7.5 Computing's Impact on Individuals and Society

blocks.text: Computing systems have changed how we live, work and communicate. The spread of the internet, smartphones and artificial intelligence has brought both positive and negative impacts.

blocks.prompt: Name one positive and one negative impact of computing.
blocks.explanation: Positive: easier access to information and education. Negative: misinformation spreading quickly.

items: Computing brings both benefits and harms to individuals and society.
